context: A doctor briefs about geriatric safety
purpose: Teach: 転倒/手当て/灰色/大小/スカイ/ナビ/相手方/袖

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、高齢者の転倒、近年増加傾向です。
lines.en: Ren, elderly falls have been increasing noticeably in recent years.
lines.style: Measured, matter-of-fact opening. Clinical but not cold. Delivers the fact with steady eye contact, as if presenting something important but routine. No dramatization.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 軽い手当てで済む例もあれば、深刻なものも。
lines.en: Some of them turn out to be minor — just first aid — but others can be very serious.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine curiosity underneath. Hesitates slightly before 'serious' as if weighing the weight of it. Leans forward slightly, engaging with the complexity rather than the simplicity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。骨折、灰色の長期予後があります。
lines.en: Yes. Fractures especially — their long-term outcomes can be unpredictable.
lines.style: Calm, measured confirmation. Quiet weight on 'unpredictable.' Not rushed. The tone of someone who has seen enough to know there are no easy answers. Steady breathing.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 大小の事故、現場で見られるんですね。
lines.en: So you see accidents of all kinds out there in the field.
lines.style: Genuine interest — not testing, but truly wanting to understand. Slight lean-in with the question. Respectful of the experience being described. Soft, engaged tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。救急ヘリのスカイ運航、活用しています。
lines.en: Yes. We make use of emergency helicopters when the situation calls for it.
lines.style: Factual delivery, but with quiet pride in the capability. Not boastful — just clear about the resources and when they're deployed. Steady, professional.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 救急車のナビ、慎重ですか。
lines.en: So navigation and routing — that requires real precision?
lines.style: Probing gently, not interrogating. Recognition that this is important detail work. Slight upward inflection on the question, inviting her to expand. Respectful attention.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい。事故の相手方、家族にも丁寧に対応します。
lines.en: Yes. We treat families of the other party with the same care and consideration.
lines.style: Steady, affirming. Quiet emphasis on 'same care' — not a casual statement but a principle. No defensiveness, just clarity. Breath through the full sentence.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 袖を引っ張る程度の小さなクレームでも、誠実に。
lines.en: Even the smallest complaint — someone just pulling at your sleeve — we take seriously and respond with sincerity.
lines.style: Reflective, quieter now. The metaphor of 'pulling at your sleeve' lands gently. Genuine belief in the principle, not performance. Trailing breath at the end, a natural close to the exchange.
